editorWhyPickModel: Choose the continue and check models in Settings under AI
settingsModelDataNote: Context limits and largest outputs come from models.dev, shared by all works
settingsModelsAutoNote: When on, the app asks models.dev once in the background after it starts, at most once a day. It only fetches public model data and sends nothing of your works or settings.
settingsModelsNever: Never synced; using the data built into the app
settingsModelsSyncNote: Sync Now asks models.dev right away.
settingsLocalNote: Local address: make sure this service doesn’t forward to the cloud
settingsRemoteNote: Remote service: chat content will be sent to this address
settingsKeyEmptyNew: Leave empty to use no key
settingsKeyEmptySaved: Leave empty to keep the saved key
settingsKeyNote: Keys are stored in the system keychain and never written to config files or books.
settingsNoModels: No models yet. Fetch the available models or add one manually.
settingsCompressNote: When a chat exceeds the compress threshold, earlier messages are summarized.
settingsModelsFetched: Model list fetched. It takes effect after you save the provider.
settingsIDRule: A provider ID may use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, and must start with a letter
settingsURLScheme: The API address must start with http:// or https://
settingsURLNoHost: The API address has no host name
settingsURLExtra: The API address can’t include an account, query or anchor
settingsEnvRule: An environment variable name may use only letters, digits and _, and can’t start with a digit
settingsModelDup: Model {id} is listed more than once
